resources.string: This app allows you to view 3D models that you have downloaded, or open 3D models directly from your browser. Supports STL, OBJ, PLY, and OpenVDB (VDB) models. Tap the VR button at the bottom to view the model in your VR headset!\n\nCopyright © 2017+ Dmitry Brant.
